upgrades.name: Stockpile
upgrades.text: +3 materials to start each run.

upgrades.name: Veterans
upgrades.text: One more plain card in the starting deck.

upgrades.name: Requisition
upgrades.text: Choose a card to add to the starting deck.

upgrades.name: Heirloom
upgrades.text: Start each run with a random Stellar emblem.

upgrades.name: Armoured slots
upgrades.text: +1 defence on every slot of your tableau.

upgrades.name: Shield emitters
upgrades.text: Your sun starts every battle with +1 shield.

upgrades.name: Bastion
upgrades.text: Your Guards have +2 defence in battle.

upgrades.name: Halo mantle
upgrades.text: +1 shield on your sun every day of battle.

upgrades.name: Anchored space
upgrades.text: Regional stability holds one turn longer in every galaxy.

upgrades.name: Trade friends
upgrades.text: Space station cards cost 1 material less.

upgrades.name: Founders' Hoard
upgrades.text: +6 materials whenever you enter a new galaxy.

upgrades.name: Quartermaster
upgrades.text: Every space station stocks 3 more cards.

upgrades.name: Cryo core
upgrades.text: Your sun starts every battle 1 cooler.

upgrades.name: Stellar plating
upgrades.text: +2 max health on your sun in battle.

upgrades.name: Field cooling
upgrades.text: Your sun cools 1 each jump.

upgrades.name: Stellari's Favour
upgrades.text: Your sun cools 3 after each battle won.

upgrades.name: Fertile orbit
upgrades.text: The abundant planet draws 1 more card each day it faces your sun.

upgrades.name: Deep foundries
upgrades.text: The industrial planet gives 1 more energy each day it faces your sun.

upgrades.name: Cold world
upgrades.text: The dead planet cools your sun by 2 each dawn it faces it.

upgrades.name: Aligned worlds
upgrades.text: Every planet gives more again: +1 card, +1 energy, 2 more cooling.

upgrades.name: Kinship
upgrades.text: Your favoured race's cards come up more often among rewards.

upgrades.name: Salvage crews
upgrades.text: More chance of finding an emblem after a battle won.

upgrades.name: Fellowship
upgrades.text: A second race's cards come up a little more often among rewards.

upgrades.name: Scavengers
upgrades.text: One more card to choose from when salvaging.

upgrades.name: Wide offers
upgrades.text: One more card to choose from in every card reward.

upgrades.name: Plunder
upgrades.text: +2 materials for every battle won.

upgrades.name: Overlord's vault
upgrades.text: Every Overlord's hoard offers 2 more cards to choose from.

upgrades.name: Study
upgrades.text: +10% experience from everything.

upgrades.name: Petal pouch
upgrades.text: +20% petals at every wormhole.

upgrades.name: Overlord's tithe
upgrades.text: +2 petals from every Overlord beaten.

upgrades.name: Legacy
upgrades.text: +1 petal for every battle won.
